chunks: Sa‘d ibn ‘Abdallah and al-Himyari together narrated from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, from his brother Ali, from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, who said:

Muhammad ibn Ali passed away when he was twenty-five years, three months, and twelve days old. He died on a Tuesday, with six days having passed of Dhu al-Hijjah, in the year two hundred and twenty. He lived after his father for nineteen years, except for twenty-five days.

key_terms.الثُّلَاثَاءِ: Tuesday, the day of his passing
key_terms.ذِي الْحِجَّةِ: Dhu al-Hijjah, the lunar month in which the death occurred
key_terms.قُبِضَ: passed away; was taken in death
key_terms.مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ: Muhammad ibn Ali, the Imam being described

ai.seo_question: When did Muhammad ibn Ali عليه السلام pass away, and how old was he?
ai.summary: This report records the age, date of death, and length of time Muhammad ibn Ali lived after his father. It serves as a brief biographical notice preserving chronological details about the Imam عليه السلام in the hadith tradition.

en.sarwar: 12. Sa‘d ibn ‘Abdallah and Ali-Himyari all have narrated fom Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar from his brother Ali from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Muhammad ibn Sinan who has said the following.

“Muhammad ibn Ali (a.s.) passed away at the age of twenty five years, three months and twelve days. He died on a Tuesday on the sixth of Dhil Hajj in the year two hundred twenty AH. He lived nineteen years less twenty five days.”
